model.name: Semantic drift guards — task/req AC parity + QA-switch-state validity + metric-completeness (the axes R37.3's byte-check is blind to)
model.description: R37.3's fail-loud guard asserts pin==board==files by BYTE-IDENTITY (view==f(units)) — but that STRUCTURAL byte-check is BLIND to SEMANTIC drift the planner's 4-axis finding exposed. This requirement folds the 3 unguarded SEMANTIC drift axes into ci as FAILABLE guards (same 1->0 shape), extending R37.3 to the semantic siblings its structural guard cannot see: (AXIS-2) task<->req AC PARITY - a task's coveredRequirements ACs must match the covering requirement's ACs (T37.20 showed task-md 6 vs req 7 while the byte-check stayed GREEN); (AXIS-3) QA-IS-A-SWITCH-STATE VALIDITY - a QA-Review item must carry a named waiting-on + switch-direction, and evidence-invalidated => NOT QA (T40.85 sat done-while-broken); (AXIS-4) METRIC-COMPLETENESS - the drift --check must NOT silently exclude frozen-legacy/missing-file-creation (it undercounted true drift ~28x, 7 vs 200): every excluded category is COUNTED or DECLARED-excluded, never silently dropped.

discoverySource.note: AXIS-1 is R37.3's structural byte-check (covered); AXIS-2/3/4 are the SEMANTIC siblings the byte-check is BLIND to. Real cases: T37.20 (task-md 6 vs req 7), T40.85 (Done-while-broken), 7-vs-200 undercount.

model.queuePriority: follows R37.3 (structural guard) — semantic-drift extension; planner boards a covering task per axis (3 lints), tester owns the lints
model.crossRefNote: EXTENDS R37.3 (1530c79c, fail-loud pin==board==files byte-check) to the SEMANTIC drift axes it is blind to - child not sibling (extendsRequirement). AXIS-2 exposed by T37.20/R37.20 (task-md 6 vs req 7). AXIS-4 refines R37.3 no-vacuous-truth (all-or-nothing -> per-category-accounted). Same 1->0 failable shape as R37.2/R37.3 gates.

acceptanceCriteria.text: AXIS-2: a task's rendered ACs (task-md) must MATCH its covering requirement's ACs (count + ids); a task-md showing N ACs while its covered req has M!=N => RED. The T37.20 case (task-md 6 vs req 7) that the byte-check stayed GREEN on is caught. 1->0.

gateRef.assertion: for each task: task-md AC set == covered-req AC set (count+ids), else RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a task-md AC count != covered-req AC count -> RED (reproduces T37.20 6-vs-7)

acceptanceCriteria.text: AXIS-3: a QA-Review item is a SWITCH STATE - it must carry a named waiting-on + switch-direction; a QA-Review item with no waiting-on/switch-direction OR whose evidence is INVALIDATED is NOT validly QA => RED. Catches T40.85 (sat Done-while-broken). 1->0.

gateRef.assertion: a QA-Review item lacking waiting-on+switch-direction, or with invalidated evidence, => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a QA-Review item with no waiting-on (or invalidated evidence) -> RED (reproduces T40.85)

acceptanceCriteria.text: AXIS-4: the drift --check must NOT silently exclude any category (frozen-legacy, missing-file-creation) - every excluded unit/category is COUNTED or explicitly DECLARED-excluded (with a named reason), never silently dropped. The ~28x undercount (7 reported vs 200 true) => RED. Refines R37.3 no-vacuous-truth from all-or-nothing to per-category-accounted. 1->0.

gateRef.assertion: excluded-count + checked-count == total; a silently-excluded category (uncounted, undeclared) => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a silently-excluded frozen-legacy category -> RED (reproduces 7-vs-200 undercount)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each axis lint is FAILABLE with its own RED-proving stub (same 1->0 shape as the existing R37.3/R37.2 gates) - a lint that cannot go RED on its axis's seeded drift is unproven and inadmissible (generalizes R37.3 AC-BITE to the 3 semantic axes).

gateRef.assertion: each axis lint observed RED on its seeded drift before it counts as wired

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: lint unbuilt; RED-proving stub per axis on build (1->0)
